[[File:Tholoth.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] in her Tholoth headdress.]]

'''Tholoth headdresses''' were traditional articles of clothing worn by women of [[Tholoth/Legends|Tholoth]] heritage. They were made up of long, fleshy tendrils. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] both wore Tholoth headdresses, along with [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]].
